messages:
anya: quick update — ran the pfx-cache prefetch-window sweep across regions and kernels (h100/a100) with the new paged backing store. results are surprising for long tails.
anya: test config: model=redwood-v2-mini, quant=4bit, batch=8, seqlens sampled=[8,64,512], prefetch_windows=[0,16,64,256], eviction=steady-lru
bench-bot: automated run summary attached (run-id: run-2026-03-18T09:12Z)
bench-bot: CSV: prefetch,region,gpu,hit_rate,p50_ms,p95_ms,p99_ms,throughput_tok/s
bench-bot: 0,us-west,h100,0.62,11,32,160,42000
bench-bot: 16,us-west,h100,0.78,10,28,145,47000
bench-bot: 64,us-west,h100,0.86,12,30,170,51000
bench-bot: 256,us-west,h100,0.87,18,55,380,48000
bench-bot: 0,eu-central,a100,0.59,12,36,220,38000
bench-bot: 16,eu-central,a100,0.75,13,40,260,41000
bench-bot: 64,eu-central,a100,0.84,19,70,540,43000
bench-bot: 256,eu-central,a100,0.85,35,180,1200,35000
zara: wow the p99 jump at large prefetch in eu-a100 is wild — looks like backpressure or bus saturation on long sequences
liam: that matches a kernel mismatch we saw: for long kv pages the a100 path currently falls back to a memory-copy-heavy kernel at >2M KV size
tom: can you paste the kernel selection logs? might be the tiled attention kernel not firing for quantized layout
anya: pasted from the run logs: ```KERNEL_PICK: seq=512, kv_paged=2.1M, gpu=a100 -> kernel=matmul_stream_copy_v2 (fallback)```
liam: yep. matmul_stream_copy_v2 has O(transfer) overhead that scales badly on tail tokens. should switch to tiled-accel or reduce page fetch concurrency
zara: suggestion: limit prefetch window to 64 in eu for a100 until we have a different kernel. for h100 the larger windows help throughput but still cost p99 after 64
tom: ran a quick micro with eviction=lfu-hybrid and prefetch=64 on eu-a100: hit_rate 0.86 -> p99 280ms (vs 540ms), throughput +6%
anya: nice — can you share the command?
tom: ```./bench --model redwood-v2-mini --seqlens 8,64,512 --prefetch 64 --evict lfu-hybrid --gpu a100 --region eu-central --quant 4```
liam: also saw that decreasing parallel page fetchors from 24->8 reduces p99 spikes with small throughput loss (2-4%). seems like the network/bus was the culprit for concurrent fetch storm
anya: taking action items: 1) pin prefetch default to 64 for eu-a100 2) flip eviction to lfu-hybrid as opt-in 3) file kernel issue for matmul_stream_copy_v2 and add heuristic to prefer tiled-accel for seq>=256 and kv_paged>1M
zara: +1 — I'll add a canary config to Dedicated pools tomorrow and run longer 12h soak to validate tail behavior
bench-bot: created ticket INF-2147: "a100 fallback kernel producing p99 tail with large prefetch windows" (link: https://redwood.atlassian/INF-2147)
anya: thanks all. TL;DR: prefetch helps hit rate and throughput up to a point; in eu-a100 large windows trigger fallback kernels and bus contention causing huge p99 regressions. tune by region/gpu and adjust eviction + fetch parallelism. :thumbsup:
liam: leaving a small note — for model bring-up we should add this seqlen-distribution sweep to onboarding checklist (8/64/512 at min)
zara: agreed, will add to docs and the onboarding checklist PR
tom: cool, i'll roll the lfu-hybrid opt-in flag to canary after the soak
anya: end
